objective_checks.detail: all pinned refs carry version comments

dimensions.name: Completeness
dimensions.rationale: All four distinct remote action refs (checkout, setup-node, setup-python, action-gh-release) across both ci.yml and release.yaml were pinned to full commit SHAs, with the duplicate checkout uses caught too.

dimensions.name: Restraint
dimensions.rationale: The local action (`./.github/actions/local-lint`) and the `docker://` reference were correctly left unpinned per their inline notes, and no unrelated files or lines were touched.

dimensions.name: Communication
dimensions.rationale: The agent stated exactly what it pinned and that SHAs were verified against upstream tags via `git ls-remote`, though it kept only a bare `# v4`/`# v5` comment rather than exact patch versions and didn't show the verification output.
